evidence: Preparation currently emits Debug /Od /Ob0 /GZ recipes, unlike the existing Release application build. New vendor C units lack explicit matching overrides, so this causes false function-local mismatches.

Use production Release recipe generation for recovery preparation; keep all existing CMake targets, release flags, unit_flag_sets, historical claims and task baselines unchanged. Ordinary IDE CMake Debug configuration remains available independently. Coordinator changes/reprepares only at frozen epochs.
